scheme_name: The Mizoram Provisional Employees Savings Scheme
other_conditions: Provisional employees must have their engagement approved by the Department of Personnel & Administrative Reforms (DP&AR) and the Finance Department of Mizoram
Employees must be registered under the Mizoram Employee Provident Scheme
Employees must nominate family members as beneficiaries
Contribution starts from the month following the month of joining the service
Partial withdrawals are allowed only after a minimum of 5 years of participation and are limited to ¼ of the account balance, up to two times during the entire service
benefits_summary: Provides provisional employees with a pension through mandatory monthly contributions and offers flexible partial and exit withdrawals for education, marriage, housing, and medical needs.
